summary: Short north kerb fronting houses and a kindergarten; dwellings 14-20 m on this side.

best_section.where: Macquarie Street north kerb, in front of the houses by the kindergarten

drivers.seclusion: Houses and a kindergarten sit behind the kerb; nearest dwelling 14 m, another 20 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars already parked along both kerbs; room for one van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, school drop-off traffic on schooldays.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb, with a 1/2P schooldays 7am-7pm sign at the kerb.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m on the section's own side
Low-lying: about 5.5 m elevation, Brisbane River 143 m away
sun_shade: Large tree canopy shades the kerb from the north and east; morning sun partly blocked.
